intro.h2: Cabinetry and furniture built as one-of-a-kind pieces
paragraphs: William Olsen Designs makes custom cabinetry in Phoenix, OR, with the eye of a fine furniture maker. Cherry drawers are joined with exposed dovetails, woods are picked for their figure, and built-ins are designed around the room they will live in.

One family has four large built-ins from William and says visitors admire them every time. Another client commissioned a dining table in Chinese elm and English walnut, plus a cherry blossom triptych for the wall behind it. She is honest that his prices may be a bit more than average, and just as clear that the one-of-a-kind result is worth it.

items.name: Built-ins and wall units
items.blurb: Full-wall cabinetry with lit display shelves, art niches and drawers below, designed around your room and what you want to show. One client has four large built-ins in her home and calls each one a statement of design, creativity and function.

image.alt: Cherry wall unit with glowing display shelves, a framed landscape painting niche and cabinet doors below

items.name: Kitchen cabinets
items.blurb: Solid wood kitchen cabinetry built in the shop and fitted on site, like this warm wood kitchen with open corner shelves, a tiled backsplash and trim that frames the window over the sink. Each kitchen is made to fit its own walls.

image.alt: Wood kitchen cabinets around a double window with a green tile backsplash and open corner shelving

items.name: Fine furniture
items.blurb: Dining tables, sideboards and entryway tables in eastern cherry, figured maple, western black walnut, bigleaf maple, Chinese elm and English walnut. A reviewer calls her elm and walnut table stunning and describes the work as fine, one-of-a-kind custom furniture.

image.alt: Cherry sideboard with three paneled doors set in a black frame on a light wood floor

items.name: Wall art and small pieces
items.blurb: Not every commission is large. William has made a cherry blossom triptych to hang above a dining table and builds traditional sushi trays to order in figured maple, black walnut, cherry and rosewood. Ask for a quote on smaller pieces too.

image.alt: Three-panel cherry blossom wood art above a hardwood dining table with orange chairs

items.name: Vans and commercial work
items.blurb: The shop works for residential and commercial clients, and not every project is a house. In 2013 William helped design and build birch side panels for a Sprinter van, and seven years later the owner said the panels were still serving him beautifully.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of the finished interior of a high-roof cargo van converted for travel: smooth light birch plywood wall panels with simple multifaceted angled sections, a birch platform bed base with storage drawers, warm cherry-toned trim, soft natural daylight through the open rear doors with a glimpse of a forested Southern Oregon mountain road, uncluttered, no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names, no vehicle badges, 4:3 aspect ratio.
image.alt: Camper van interior lined with light birch wall panels and a birch bed base (illustration)

items.title: Furniture-grade joinery
items.text: Drawers are joined with exposed dovetails, like the cherry drawers in the shop's photos. A van owner says panels William built in 2013 were still serving him beautifully seven years later.

items.title: Wood with character
items.text: William works in figured maple, eastern cherry, western black walnut, bigleaf maple, Chinese elm, English walnut and birch, and the finished pieces show off the grain.

items.title: A real professional shop
items.text: A client points out that the shop has the latest, top-notch tools and equipment, and calls it an incredibly professional custom woodworking outfit, not a garage operation.

items.title: Easy to work with
items.text: Reviewers describe William as a joy to work with, a stand up businessman with integrity and a great sense of humor. One family says they would use no one else.

about.text: William Olsen Designs is a cabinet and fine furniture shop at 216 Houston Rd in Phoenix, Oregon. The business specializes in sustainably eco-friendly fine furniture and custom cabinetry, and William designs the work and builds it in his own shop. His clients use words like artistry and integrity, and also mention his great sense of humor and how easy he is to work with. The shop handles residential and commercial projects, from large built-ins and kitchen cabinets to a single entryway table, and his Facebook posts invite you to request a quote.
about.owner_role: Designer and woodworker, namesake of the business

image.alt: Live-edge hardwood slab on a jointer bed inside the woodworking shop

process.h2: How a custom piece comes together

steps.title: Request a quote
steps.text: Call (541) 326-1652 or email willolsendesigns@aol.com with what you have in mind, the room it is for and any photos or measurements.

steps.title: Design together
steps.text: William works through the design with you, balancing looks and function, the way one client says he helped design his multifaceted van panels.

steps.title: Choose the wood
steps.text: Pick from species like cherry, figured maple, black walnut, bigleaf maple or elm, and William selects boards with the grain your piece needs.

steps.title: Build in the shop
steps.text: Your cabinetry or furniture is milled, joined and finished in the Phoenix shop using professional tools and equipment, with built-ins and cabinets then fitted in place.

items.name: Elizabeth H.
items.text: It is difficult to express in words the absolute artistry William Olsen brings to his pieces.  He has completed 4 large built-ins for our home and each one is a statement of the utmost in professional design, creativity and functionality. Visitors to our home admire his pieces every time.  William is a joy to work with, too.  We would have no one else do any custom wood work in our home.

items.name: Erin D.
items.text:
William Olsen made a beautiful dining table for me with Chinese Elm and English Walnut. I just LOVE it! The wood is stunning. He also made the cherry blossom triptych art on the wall behind the table. Just beautiful.

William Olsen is a stand up businessman and craftsman with integrity and a great sense of humor. His prices may be a bit more than the average furniture/cabinet maker, but what you get is FINE custom
One-of-a-kind work! I can't recommend enough.

items.name: Sergei B.
items.text: William Olsen Designs helped me design and build simple/multifaceted birch side panels for my Sprinter van in 2013. Seven years later, my panels are still serving me beautifully! William is a skilled woodworker through and through and I will gladly use his services again in the future. It’s also worth noting that William Olsen Designs is equipped with all the latest, top-notch tools and equipment. This is not another hipster garage shop, but an incredibly professional, custom woodworking outfit.

service_area.text: The shop is at 216 Houston Rd in Phoenix, Oregon, and Phoenix is the town listed for the business. Cabinetry and built-ins are fitted in your home, while furniture and smaller pieces are built in the shop. If you are nearby and want to know whether William can take on a built-in or kitchen at your address, call (541) 326-1652.

items.q: What does William Olsen Designs make?
items.a: Custom cabinetry, large built-ins and wall units, kitchen cabinets and fine furniture such as dining tables, sideboards and entryway tables. William has also made wall art, traditional sushi trays and birch panels for a Sprinter van. The shop takes residential and commercial work.

Usually a little. One client wrote that William's prices may be a bit more than the average furniture or cabinet maker, but that what you get is fine, one-of-a-kind custom work. Call for a quote on your piece so you know the cost before work starts.

items.q: Which woods can I choose from?
items.a: Pieces shown in reviews and on Facebook use eastern cherry, figured maple, western black walnut, bigleaf maple, Chinese elm, English walnut and birch, with rosewood offered for small items. William focuses on sustainably eco-friendly fine furniture and cabinetry, so ask about the source of the wood for your project.

The shop is open Monday to Thursday from 7:30 AM to 5 PM and Friday from 7:30 AM to 4 PM. It is closed on Saturday and Sunday. Call (541) 326-1652 during those hours or email willolsendesigns@aol.com any time with photos or a sketch of your idea.

William Olsen Designs is at 216 Houston Rd, Phoenix, OR 97535. The shop is set up with professional woodworking tools and equipment, which one client called incredibly professional. Please call ahead at (541) 326-1652 before visiting so William can make time to talk.

final_cta.h2: Have a built-in or table in mind?
final_cta.text: Tell William about the room and the wood you love, and ask for a quote.
